description.value: Mineiros Brazilian Bistro is a casual bistro in Burnaby serving Brazilian specialties including coxinha (crispy chicken-filled dough bites) and brigadeiro chocolates. Formerly operating as BrazEuro, the spot offers both pickup and delivery through online ordering. It sits on Edmonds Street and would make a distinctive stop for cyclists looking for something beyond typical café fare.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content at mineirosbrazilianbistrobc.com corroborates the phone number and street address but clearly identifies the city as Burnaby, BC V3N 1B4 — not North Vancouver as listed in the OSM community field. The website's 'Order Online: Pickup Delivery' section confirms takeout is available. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the business website explicitly identifies the location as Burnaby, BC V3N 1B4. The address field has been corrected to Burnaby based on website evidence.
OSM old_name tag records a prior name 'BrazEuro' — the business has rebranded but OSM may not fully reflect this in all fields.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active business with a functioning website and online ordering. Serves food and takeout, which is useful to touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: Brazilian specialties including coxinha and brigadeiro chocolates
